verdict.rationale: Martin's docs include a dedicated background-tasks section. It covers recurring daily or weekly briefings, automatic email labeling with follow-up actions, proactive email drafting and sending, and scheduled wake-up calls. These are recurring, autonomous behaviors rather than one-off actions. However, they are preset task types. The only user-defined automation evidenced is custom shortcuts, which trigger multi-step actions on demand rather than running in the background. Missing for 10: user-configurable custom background automations with arbitrary triggers or schedules, in-depth docs beyond one-line summaries, and independent hands-on corroboration that background tasks run reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Martin can send you daily or weekly briefings via email.
Martin can automatically label your emails and take follow up actions on your behalf.
Martin can proactively draft emails for you and send them on your behalf.
Martin can call you at a specific time every morning to wake you up with the weather and your schedule.
Create custom shortcuts that trigger multi-step actions.
